RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  November 15, 2010/Kartika 24, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women
and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
26
Release of funds under Multi-sectoral
Development Programme
†*81. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of MINORITY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the amount released to the States
from the funds allocated for the financial
year 2010-11 by the Central Government
for different developmental works in the
areas with minority population under
Multi-sectoral Development Programme,
State-wise;
(b) the amount released so far under
this Programme, State-wise and Scheme-
wise; and
(c) whether the funds allocated under
this Programme would be spent by March,
2011?
Status of marriage between minors
*82. SHRIMATI JAYANTHI
NATARAJAN: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Delhi
High Court has recently declared marriage
between two minors as valid;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government with
regard to this verdict and what action
Government proposes to take thereon?
Tree plantation
*83. SHRI A VINASH RAI KHANNA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government and Non-
Governmental Organisations (NGOs) have
been leading a campaign to plant trees in
different States;
(b) if so, whether the area under tree
plantation has been increased;
(c) if so, the result thereof during the
last three years;
(d) the details of tubewells in the
country in private and Government sector,
State-wise;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

27
(e) if four trees are planted on each
tubewell, then how much area would be
covered under plantation;
(f) whether Government is planning to
launch this programme in the country; and
(g) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Gas supply for power projects
*84. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry has sought an
allocation of 14.5 million metric standard
cubic metres per day (mmscmd) of gas
from Reliance Industries’ KG basin facility
for four power projects poised to produce
nearly 4,136 MW of power during the
current plan, during the last meeting of
EGoM, headed by the Finance Minister;
(b) whether the Ministry in its
submission had recommended to EGoM
allocation of 8 mmscmd of gas for 2,400
MW expansion project planned by Reliance
Power Ltd. at Samalkot in Andhra Pradesh;
and
(c) if so, to what extent the Ministry
has been able to get gas supply for the four
projects?
Use of money and muscle power
during elections
*85. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Election Commission
of India had called an all party meeting
recently to discuss the issues related to use
of money and muscle power in elections
and communalisation of politics;
(b) if so, the parties which participated
in the deliberations;
(c) the outcome thereof; and
(d) the follow-up action taken in the
matter?
Inclusion of communities in ST List
*86. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of TRIBAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any representation from
Government of Assam has been received
by the Ministry, recommending a review
to provide ST status to the six communities
namely Koch Rajbangshi, Tai Ahom,
Moran, Mattak, Tiwa and Tea Tribes, of
the State, who are demanding this status
for decades;
(b) if so, the details thereof,
community-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that large scale
public resentment and protests have been
reported and the matter has been creating
disturbed and violent situation in recent
times throughout the State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Power generation
*87. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the details of sources from which
power is being generated in each State along
with the quantum of power generated
during the last five years, State-wise;
(b) the details of power projects which
are pending at present and by when these
are likely to be completed; and
(c) by when our country is likely to
become self-sufficient in power sector?

28
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Eviction of tribals
*88. SHRI T.M. SELV AGANAPA THI:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Government had asked the State
Governments and Union Territories’
Administration not to evict the tribals from
the parks, etc. till they are properly
rehabilitated;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Central Government had also asked the
State Governments and Union Territories’
Administration to strictly comply with the
Forests Act; and
(d) if so, their reaction thereto?
Rehabilitation of people displaced due
to mining
*89. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) the population displaced from their
lands/habitations in mineral reserves in the
States during the last five years, State-wise;
(b) whether families so displaced have
been duly rehabilitated;
(c) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the manner and the time-frame for
rehabilitation, State-wise;
(d) special measures taken for their
cultural, social and emotional rehabilitation;
(e) what are the instructions/policy of
the Central Government  in this context
and how far they have been followed,
State-wise; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Emission of toxic gases
†*90. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that emission of
toxic gases is rising with the increasing pace
of development in the country;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether Government has identified
the areas polluting the country's
environment; and
(d) if so, the sources of pollution and
their contribution to the environmental
pollution?
Funds to Jharkhand for minorities
*91. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the funds released for the minorities
of Jharkhand during the last three years,
district-wise and year-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that the funds for
minorities for some districts have not gone
to Jharkhand at all during the last two years;
and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?
Environmental clearance to second
airport site in Mumbai
*92. SHRI PRAKASH JA V ADEKAR:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has given
environmental clearance to second airport
site in Mumbai;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

29
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Electrification of rural areas of Orissa
*93. SHRIMATI RENUBALA
PRADHAN: Will the Minister of NEW
AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of rural areas/villages
proposed to be electrified through
renewable energy in Orissa during the
current year;
(b) the progress made, so far;
(c) the sources of the renewable energy
identified for this purpose;
(d) the potential of wind energy in
Orissa and whether there is any plan to
establish the wind energy farms in the State;
and
(e) if so, the locations thereof and their
capacity to generate energy?
Filling up of pits by CIL
*94. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of COAL
be pleased to state:
(a) whether huge pits have been created
as a result of extraction of coal by the Coal
India Limited (CIL) and its subsidiaries,
particularly by CCL, BCCL, ECL, WCL,
MCL, NLC etc., which have been
abandoned unfilled;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for not filling up these
pits;
(d) whether these pits have posed a
threat to the environment and the lives and
property of the people of the area; and
(e) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard?
Study report on glaciers
*95. SHRIMATI T. RA TNA BAI: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any report on glaciers study recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the present status thereof?
Telecast of "Big Boss" programme
†*96. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that whatever is
being shown to the citizens of the country
in daily soap "Big Boss" by Colors channel
is against the social values;
(b) if so, whether the Ministry is going
to take any action against the producers of
such type of programmes, especially of
"Big Boss" and its channel owners; and
(c) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Censorship of TV programmes
†*97. SHRI Y .P. TRIVEDI: Will the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether there should be censorship
of television on the line of feature films, as
it is becoming difficult to view programmes
being shown by some television channels
in the name of reality shows in order to
increase TRP with children which are
adversely affecting them;
(b) whether it should be made
compulsory for these programmes to obtain
certificates, like films;

30
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 9th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Kartika 18, 1932 (Saka)
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government proposes to
make any law to prevent or not to telecast
those serials at prime time or to telecast
them in the late night hours and if so, by
when and the details thereof?
New Mineral policy for socio-
economic benefits to people
*98. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has evolved a
new Mineral Policy keeping in view the
interests of people of Jharkhand as regards
the potential accrual of socio-economic
benefits to them, consequent to exploration
of mineral resources;
(b) if so, the details of the Policy
indicating the nature and quantum of
enhancement in benefits estimated to be
accruing to masses in the State and
distinctions thereof vis-a-vis  the earlier
Mineral Policy;
(c) whether Government has assessed
the volume of population which is
vulnerable to  displacement owing to
enhanced exploration of mineral reserves
in the State;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the measures taken for their
rehabilitation?
Election Commission's response to
paid news
*99. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Election Commission
(EC) has recently rejected the view of the
Press Council of India on paid news;
(b) if so, the details of the
recommendations made by the Press
Council of India on paid news;
(c) whether the incidents of paid news,
particularly at the time of elections, increase
and it becomes difficult for the Commission
to take action at once; and
(d) if so, the details of the further steps
Government proposes to take in this regard?
Action plan on cleaning Ganga
†*100. SHRI JAI PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any report/suggestion in response to   its
request made to the IIT scientists for
submitting an action plan to the National
Ganga River Basin Authority for cleaning
of river Ganga;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to implement the same?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Coal : 94,
Corporate Affairs : —
Development of North Eastern Region : —
Environment and Forests : 83, 90, 92, 95, 100,
Food Processing Industries : —
Information and Broadcasting : 96, 97,
Law and Justice : 82, 85, 99,
Mines : 89, 98,
Minority Affairs : 81, 91,
New and Renewable Energy : 93,
Power : 84, 87,
Statistics and Programme Implementation : —
Tribal Affairs : 86, 88.
Women and Child Development : —
